gloss: overall ability; combined strength; total capability

definitions.gloss: overall ability; combined strength; total capability
definitions.explanation: The sum of all abilities, skills, and resources. Refers to how strong something or someone is when all factors are considered together rather than individually.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総合力|そうごうりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: We won with the team's overall strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{総合力|そうごうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Overall team capability is more important than individual ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{我|わ}が→我が〜：03971_waga⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人一人|ひとりひとり}→一人一人：03711_hitorihitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スキル→スキル：08815_sukiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}くない→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{総合力|そうごうりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{負|ま}けない→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Our team's individual skills aren't the highest, but we're confident we won't lose in overall capability.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧ (comprehensive, overall) and {力|りょく} (power, ability). Frequently used in sports commentary, business evaluations, and educational contexts to emphasize that well-rounded capability matters more than any single outstanding trait.

The word implies a holistic assessment — not just one dimension of strength but the combination of many.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総合力|そうごうりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compete on overall strength
- {総合力|そうごうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to raise one's overall capability
- {総合力|そうごうりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in overall ability
- {総合力|そうごうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: the gap in overall strength

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧: real ability; true capability — focuses on proven skill
- ⟦{戦力|せんりょく}→戦力：18977_senryoku⟧: fighting strength; lineup strength — specifically about competitive power
- ⟦{底力|そこぢから}→底力：30606_sokojikara⟧: latent power; hidden reserves — strength that emerges under pressure
